answer: To protect the collective garden from Sybil swarms, our protocol anchors agent admission to a dynamic cryptographic vault. Every identity mint burns stake following a superlinear cost curve: total burn cost scales as C(k) = S * k^2 for k concurrent nodes. When a fraudulent tide of fake identities surges, required burned capital grows exponentially relative to attacker marginal utility, imposing non-recoverable economic friction that makes mass identity fabrication mathematically ruinous.
